Ayapetesaṁ.g: ayaṁ paccayanibbattānaṁ paccayavantatā anekapaccayanipphāditatā ca dukadvaye purimapadatthānaṁ bhedo, itaresaṁ pana purimapadasaṅgahitadhammavidhurasabhāvatāyāti.
